event.description: Port closure, Gulf Coast, 48hrs — inbound alloy shipments held

evt_001.risk_summary: A high-severity weather event (“Port closure, Gulf Coast, 48hrs — inbound alloy shipments held”) has disrupted Gulf Precision Castings (Turbine housing, cast alloy), a single-source supplier with no qualified alternate. The disruption propagates to 3 downstream suppliers: Delta Assembly Works (Turbocharger subassembly), Northline Coatings (Thermal barrier coating), Cascade Final Assembly (Finished powertrain module). Principal concerns are 2 single-source dependencies in the affected path and 1 supplier already flagged on compliance.
evt_001.draft_report:
To: Compliance Contact
Subject: Supply disruption — Port closure, Gulf Coast, 48hrs — action required

A high-severity weather event has been detected affecting Gulf Coast, LA.

Directly affected:
  - Gulf Precision Castings (Turbine housing, cast alloy)

Downstream exposure:
  - Delta Assembly Works (Turbocharger subassembly)
  - Northline Coatings (Thermal barrier coating)
  - Cascade Final Assembly (Finished powertrain module)

Recommended next steps:
  1. Confirm on-hand inventory and committed orders for each part listed above.
  2. Begin qualification review for an alternate source where the affected supplier is single-source.
  3. Review the compliance status of the flagged suppliers before the next filing window.
  4. Re-assess once the disruption window closes.
